Focus on deploying your store rather than getting bogged down in non-essential details. Avoid complex marketing strategies, advanced analytics, or extensive product lists initially. Concentrate on getting your first three products loaded and ensuring that payments are functioning correctly. Once your store is live and generating sales, you can refine your marketing strategies and expand your offerings. This approach minimizes wasted time and maximizes your chances of immediate success.

Getting Your First Transaction Live

This initial transaction is crucial in testing your infrastructure and improving your system.
